name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-11-06, at wavelengths from 1.23 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
